svg.title: AUC comparison across four GPT-5.4 architectures
svg.desc: GPT-5.4 is held constant, including the Standard GPT specialist arm. Whiskers show ± sample SD. Mean normalized AUC at four evaluation cutoffs with sample standard deviation.
